$comment: C31 instance-data constraint hints (design R9). The generator derives most constraints from the model itself: array bounds from EA cardinality (task 4.3.1) and if/then/else conditionals from the condition markers in espd-edm.json (task 4.3.2). Only what the model cannot express is hand-authored here.
$todo.minimum: task 4.3.3 — QUANTITY_YEAR is OVERLOADED (count of fiscal years in C29-C32, calendar year in C49/C50, duration in C40/C41), so minimum:1 is a PER-PROPERTY bound and a datatype-level facet cannot supply it. Preferred fix: an EA tagged value exported as a `valuebounds` field on the property, following the existing `codelist` precedent in espd-tools/EAtoJSON/export-package.js. See design 'TODO (task 4.3.3)'.
$resolved.optionalLeaves: task 4.3.4 — RESOLVED: the businessDomain relaxation was WRONG and has been removed. businessDomain (RG1/RSG1/RQ2, EA cardinality 1) is present in C31/C32 (specific turnover) and ABSENT in C29/C30 (general turnover): it carries the semantic that makes the criterion 'specific', so required is correct. No Schematron rule enforces it and no example omitting it exists; the generated example already populates it, so requiring it breaks nothing. businessDomain is now required per its EA cardinality.

leafConstraints.$note: Per-leaf refinements merged into the generated shape, keyed by semantic ID. minItems on lotIdentifiers is no longer needed — it is derived from the 1..n cardinality.
